description: This Java source file defines a generic Akka actor class 'MessageAggregator' that forwards its first message to a specified recipient, collects a predetermined number of messages of a given type within a timeout period, sends the collected messages back to the original sender, and then stops itself.

classes.name: MessageAggregator
classes.description: A generic Akka actor class that aggregates messages of a specific type, forwards the first message, waits for a number of messages or timeout, then sends the collected messages back to the sender and stops.

methods.description: Handles timeout signal, logs the timeout event and proceeds to report and stop.
